class omg.si.tau.TauCosineSchedule(offset: float)[source]#

Bases: Tau

Tau function tau(t) = csc(pi / (2 + 2 * d)) * sin((pi + pi * log(t))/ (2 + 2 * d)) corresponding to a cosine noise schedule beta(s) = pi / (1 + d) tan(pi / 2 * (s + d) / (1 + d)) in a variance-preserving interpolant.

Parameters:

offset (float) – The offset d in the cosine noise schedule.

Raises:

ValueError – If offset is not zero or positive.

class omg.si.tau.TauLinearSchedule(beta_min: float, beta_max: float)[source]#

Bases: Tau

Tau function tau(t) = exp(1/2 * beta_min * log(t) - 1/4 * (beta_max - beta_min) * log^2(t)) corresponding to a linear noise schedule beta(s) = beta_min + (beta_max - beta_min) * s in a variance-preserving interpolant.

Parameters:

  • beta_min (float) – The minimum noise level.

  • beta_max (float) – The maximum noise level.

Raises:

  • ValueError – If beta_min is not positive or if beta_max is not positive.

  • ValueError – If beta_max is not greater than beta_min.
